thread:
Maya S: Quick pulse — train status for tonight's cut (v1.7.3). Cut target 18:00 PT. Candidate built and most checks green. One cherry-pick outstanding and a flaky e2e that keeps failing intermittently.

Liam R: I picked PR#4321 (bugfix for routing). Pushed to release-rail and kicked CI. Link: https://gh/redwood/pr/4321 :crossed_fingers:

Juan P: heads-up — DB migration PR#4330 needs schema owner sign-off; it's holding the auth-rollout. @Noor K can you glance?

Noor K: on it, pulling down locally now. If it's just the FK rename I can approve after a quick smoke. Expect to finish in ~30m.

Samir C: re: flaky e2e — failing in sdk-integration:TestStreamReconnect. Repro is intermittent locally too. Attempting a retry of the job now. If it flakes again we may exclude the test for the cut and create a follow-up.

Liam R: FYI I saw the same failure yesterday, looks timing-related when the mock server closes early. I have a patch but needs a release-owner ok to include. PR#4332.

Maya S: plan options: A) wait for Noor + CI to pass and proceed at 18:00, B) if flaky test blocks CI we cut with test excluded and file follow-up, C) postpone cut to 18:30 to give time for cherry and e2e. Preference for B if DB migration still pending.

release-bot: canary deployment completed at 16:42 PT — smoke checks passed (latency within 95th perc target).

infra-bot: note — GPU pool swap scheduled 19:00 PT for infra maintenance (no impact on tonight's cut unless we request scale-ups after 19:00).

Juan P: quick status — I merged the migration doc updates so Noor can sign off quicker. Moving PR#4330 -> awaiting review.

Noor K: approved and left a comment about backfill steps. Juan, please add the backfill checklist to the PR description and I'll add the label.

Samir C: CI retried and sdk-integration passed on run #2. Looks like transient. Marking as flaky but green for now.

Liam R: cherry PR#4321 CI passed, ready to merge after release lead thumbs-up.

Maya S: thanks. Since e2e passed on retry and DB approval is coming, we stick to 18:00 PT cut. If anything else pops I'll call it out here. Please ping me if you need an emergency hold. :thumbsup:

Noor K: leaving a label + backfill checklist now.

Samir C: pushing PR#4332 (timing fix) to a branch for post-cut patch.

Maya S: final ask — release owners, please do a last look at health dashboard at 17:30 PT. I'll post a final go/no-go at 17:45.

Liam R: will do.

release-bot: scheduled reminder set for 17:45 PT to /eng-releases channel.
